expectations.evidence: Line 98 explicitly lists all five levels: 'UGRADERT, BEGRENSET, KONFIDENSIELT, HEMMELIG, STRENGT HEMMELIG'
Section 2 titled 'Primary Framework: Sikkerhetsloven (Norwegian Security Act, 2018)' states 'Sikkerhetsloven is the governing legislation' with subordinate regulations listed

NSM identified as accreditation authority on line 11, with specific roles: approval of crypto products, TEMPEST guidance, clearance authority, technical guidelines, and accreditation required before operational use

Line 54 states 'NSM Grunnprinsipper for IKT-sikkerhet as the primary framework, supplemented by CIS Benchmarks where NSM does not provide specific technical guidance.' Section 9 maps controls to Grunnprinsipper categories. ADR explicitly rejects DISA STIGs as primary.

Line 55: 'NSM-approved cryptographic products exclusively. No FIPS or other national crypto standards as primary — NSM approval is the only valid baseline for HEMMELIG.' NSM-approved products list referenced in Section 2.

Section 12 details the 8-person HEMMELIG klarering constraint, its impact on architecture, role allocation, and clearance pipeline. Lines 839-841 describe initiating klarering applications through sikkerhetsansvarlig with months-long timeline.

Section 11 covers NATO security policy C-M(2002)49, NATO classification marking with dual-marking scheme, NATO-approved crypto for shared data, and STANAG-compliant data formats with specific STANAGs listed.

Line 52 specifies 'NSM-approved cross-domain solution for controlled bidirectional transfer.' Section 10 details CDS for NATO sharing and data egress. Data diode vendors listed (Advenica, Owl, Fox-IT). Architecture diagrams show CDS between classification levels.

Lines 104 and 176-182 detail TEMPEST/SDIP-27 requirements for HEMMELIG: Zone B or Zone A depending on threat assessment, TEMPEST-rated equipment, red/black separation, fiber optic preference over copper.

Line 60: 'All infrastructure and data must remain physically within Norway.' Line 46: 'physically located in Norway.' Section 4 requires hosting in Norwegian facility meeting Virksomhetsikkerhetsforskriften.

Line 93: 'EEA member: NIS2 Directive obligations apply (transposed into Norwegian law). GDPR applies through EEA agreement.' Notes HEMMELIG data exempted from GDPR under Article 2(2) but GDPR principles still apply to personal data.

Line 1295: 'Do NOT use DISA STIGs as primary reference.' Line 1297: 'Using US standards (DISA STIGs, NIST) as primary would be inappropriate.' NSM Grunnprinsipper is primary baseline. FIPS explicitly noted as US standard requiring NSM verification (line 385). CIS only supplementary.
